SHORT-TITLE CATALOG
OF
Publications and Importations
OF
SCIENTIFIC AND ENGINEERING

body.p: This list includes the technical publications of the following English publishers:
for whom D. Van Nostrand Company are the sole American agents.

p.hi: Price marked with an asterisk (*) are NET.
All bindings are in cloth unless otherwise noted.
